title: Astro Portal session event payload: mount_link_lost
description: The link to the mount dropped without being asked to (Wi-Fi gone, mount switched off, the application sent to the background long enough). Nothing is sent to the mount because of it. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

protocol.description: Optional: the mount's protocol as the application names it (`LX200`, `Alpaca`, `INDI`, `SynScan`, `iOptron`, `NexStar`).
